content: Hlang Capa a Hoeih Sak
Te phoeiah lawng khuila kun tih, a hlaikan daengah amah kho la pawk.
Te vaengah khawn tih thingkong dongah aka yalh te a taengla tarha a khuen pauh. Amih kah tangnah te Jesuh loh a hmuh coeng dongah aka khawn te, “

content.text: Ngaimong sak, ka ca, tholhnah loh nang n'hlah coeng

content: ,” a ti nah.
Te vaengah cadaek rhoek khuikah hlangvang long tah amamih khuiah, “Anih loh a soehsal coeng,” tarha a ti uh.
Jesuh loh amih kah poeknah te a hmuh tih, “

content.text: Balae tih na thinko khui ah a thae na poek uh
Na tholh loh n'hlah coeng
ti ham neh
thoo lamtah cet
ti ham he, melae yoeikoek la aka om?
Te daengah ni diklai hmankah tholh hlah ham he hlang capa loh saithainah a khueh te na ming uh eh

content: ,” a ti nah. Te phoeiah aka khawn te, “

content.text: Thoo, na phak te khuen lamtah na im la cet

content: ,” a ti nah.
Te vaengah thoo tih a im la koe cet.
Hlangping loh a hmuh vaengah a rhih uh tih, hlang taengah hebang saithainah aka pae Pathen te a thangpom uh.
Mathai a Khue
Jesuh te lamkah a khum vaengah, Matthai la a khue hlang pakhat tah mangmu doenah ah a ngol te a hmuh tih, “

content.text: Kai m'vai lah

content: ,” a ti nah. Te dongah thoo tih Jesuh taengah bang.
Im khuiah a om vaengah caboei te a vael. Te vaengah mangmucoi rhoek neh hlangtholh rhoek muep tarha ha pawk uh tih Jesuh neh a hnukbang rhoek taengah a vael uh.
Pharisee rhoek loh a hmuh uh vaengah a hnukbang rhoek taengah, “Balae tih nangmih kah saya tah mangmucoi rhoek neh hlangtholh rhoek taengah a caak,” a ti nah.
Tedae a yaak vaengah, “

content.text: Sading rhoek loh siboei a ngoe moenih, tedae tloh aka khueh rhoek long tah a ngoe
Cet uh lamtah metla a om khaw cang uh saw. Ka ngaih he tah rhennah ni hmueih te moenih. Aka dueng rhoek khue ham pawt tih aka tholh rhoek ham ni ka pawk

content: ,” a ti nah.
Yaehnah Kawng
Te phoeiah Johan kah hnukbang loh a a paan uh tih, “Balae tih kaimih neh Pharisee rhoek long tah vawpvawp ka yaeh uh. Tedae na hnukbang rhoek loh a yaeh uh moenih,” a ti nah.
Jesuh loh amih te, “

content.text: Pacaboeina loh yulueihmuen te a nguek thil thai moenih. Amih a om khuiah tah yulokung loh a om puei ta. Tedae yulokung te amih taeng lamkah loh a khue tue ha pawk vaengah a yaeh uh van bitni
Hni pen a cuemsok te himbai rhuem soah a bo moenih. A bawtnah ah te long te himbai ni a dueng tih a pawnnah te a thae la a om

Misurtui a noe te tuitang rhuem khuiah a than moenih. Te pawt koinih tuitang te paeng tih misurtui khaw cae. Te vaengah tuitang khaw poci. Tedae misurtui noe te tuitang a thai dongah a than uh atah bok sueng

content: ,” a ti nah.
Hula a Thoh, Manu Khaw Hoeih
He rhoek he amih ham a thui vaengah boei pakhat te pakcak cet tih anih te a bawk. Te phoeiah, “Ka canu he paekca ah duek dae na lo tih na kut na tloeng thil koinih hing ni,” a ti nah.
Te dongah Jesuh tah thoo tih anih te a hnukbang rhoek neh a vai phai.
Te vaengah kum hlainit khuiah aka thii nu loh a hnuk ah a paan tih a himbai dongkah salaw te a taek pah.
Amah long tah, “Jesuh kah himbai mah ka taek koinih ka hoeih ni,” a ti dongah ni.
Jesuh te mael tih huta te a hmuh vaengah, “

content.text: Ka canu na ngaimong sak, na tangnah loh nang n'khang coeng

content: ,” a ti nah. Te vaeng tue lamloh huta tah daem.
Boei im la Jesuh a pawk vaengah phavi tum neh hlangping te a sarhingrhup la hmuh.
Te dongah, “

content.text: Khoe uh lah, hula he a duek moenih, aka ip ni

content: ,” a ti nah. Te vaengah Jesuh te a nueih thiluh.
Tedae hlangping te a haek phoeiah kun tih a kut a tuuk pah vaengah hula te thoo.
He olthang loh tekah kho boeih te a pha.
Mikdael rhoi loh Kho a hmuh
Te lamloh Jesuh a khum vaengah mikdael panit loh a vai rhoi. Te vaengah pang rhoi tih, “David Capa kaimih rhoi n'rhen lah,” a ti rhoi.
Im la a pawk vaengah Jesuh te mikdael rhoi loh a paan rhoi. Te vaengah Jesuh loh amih rhoi te, “

content.text: He he ka saii thai tila na tangnah rhoi a?

content: ” a ti nah hatah, “Ue, Boeipa,” a ti rhoi.
Te phoeiah amih rhoi kah mik te a taek pah tih, “

content.text: Nangmih rhoi kah tangnah bangla nangmih taengah om saeh

content: ,” a ti nah.
Te vaengah a mik a tueng pah. Tedae Jesuh tah thanueih tih amih rhoi te, “Ngaithuen, hlang loh ming boel saeh,” a ti nah.
Tedae cet rhoi tih Jesuh kawng te kho tom ah a doek rhoi.
Rhaithae a Haek
Amih rhoi a caeh neh rhaithae aka kaem hlang pakhat hnapang te a taengla tarha a khuen uh.
Rhaithae te haek pah tih olmueh te koep cal. Te dongah hlangping tah a ngaihmang uh tih, “Israel khuiah om noek tangloeng pawh,” a ti uh.
Tedae Pharisee rhoek loh, “Rhaithae boei rhang nen ni rhaithae a haek,” a ti uh.
Boeipa Cangvuei
Te phoeiah Jesuh tah khopuei boeih neh vangca tom la cet tih amih kah tunim ah a thuituen. Ram kah olthangthen te khaw a hoe tih tlohtat boeih neh tlohnat boeih te a hoeih sak.
A hmuh vaengah amih hlangping ham te a thinphat. Tawnba la a om uh lalah tudawn aka om pawh tu bangla a voeih uh.
Te dongah a hnukbang rhoek te, “

content.text: Cangah hamla yet ngawn dae bibikung rhoek tah yolca
Te dongah cangah boeipa taengah na thangthui uh daengah ni a cangat la bibikung han tueih eh

content: ,” a ti nah.
